```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, DiagrammeR, DiagrammeRsvg, rsvg, glue, magick)

```

## IPD PRISMA Flow Diagram

```{r}
library(readr)
library(glue)
library(DiagrammeR)
library(DiagrammeRsvg)
library(rsvg)
library(magick)
library(ggplot2)
library(grid)

# 1. Load Data
if (!file.exists("Results/Descriptives/Study_Flow_Counts.csv")) {
  stop("Results/Study_Flow_Counts.csv not found. Please run 01_merge_data.Rmd first.")
}

counts <- read_csv("Results/Descriptives/Study_Flow_Counts.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# 2. Calculate aggregates for included IPD studies
n_studies_init <- nrow(counts)
n_total_init   <- sum(counts$Total, na.rm = TRUE)

n_excl_hcv <- sum(counts$Excluded_HCV, na.rm = TRUE)
n_kept_hcv <- sum(counts$Kept_HCV, na.rm = TRUE)

n_excl_fsm <- sum(counts$Excluded_MissingFSM, na.rm = TRUE)
n_kept_fsm <- sum(counts$Kept_HasFSM, na.rm = TRUE)

n_excl_val <- sum(counts$Excluded_InvalidFSM, na.rm = TRUE)
n_excl_age <- if ("Excluded_MissingAge" %in% names(counts)) {
  sum(counts$Excluded_MissingAge, na.rm = TRUE)
} else {
  0
}
n_final    <- sum(counts$Final_Analysis, na.rm = TRUE)

# Use this if some studies ended up with zero included participants
k_final <- counts %>%
  dplyr::filter(Final_Analysis > 0) %>%
  nrow()

# 3. Study-level exclusions before IPD acquisition
k_excl_acute_trials        <- 5
k_excl_chronic_no_cirr_rct <- 2
k_excl_no_te_cohort        <- 1
k_excl_no_cirr_cohort      <- 2

k_excluded_studies <- k_excl_acute_trials +
  k_excl_chronic_no_cirr_rct +
  k_excl_no_te_cohort +
  k_excl_no_cirr_cohort

k_total_evaluated <- n_studies_init + k_excluded_studies

# 4. Define diagram
diagram_code <- glue("
digraph prisma {{

  graph [layout = dot, rankdir = TB, nodesep = 0.6, ranksep = 0.7]
  
  node [shape = box,
        style = 'filled,rounded',
        fillcolor = white,
        fontname = 'Helvetica',
        fontsize = 10,
        width = 3.6]
        
  edge [fontname = 'Helvetica', fontsize = 9]

  # --- Nodes ---

  node0 [label = 'Studies evaluated for eligibility\\nk = {k_total_evaluated} studies']

  excl0 [label = 'Excluded studies\\n\\nClinical trials among people with acute/recent HCV infection, k = {k_excl_acute_trials}\\nClinical trials among people with chronic HCV infection that excluded people with cirrhosis, k = {k_excl_chronic_no_cirr_rct}\\nCohort studies among people with HCV infection that did not include transient elastography, k = {k_excl_no_te_cohort}\\nCohort studies among people with HCV infection that excluded those with cirrhosis, k = {k_excl_no_cirr_cohort}',
         fillcolor = '#ffeeee',
         width = 5.5]

  node1 [label = 'IPD obtained\\nk = {n_studies_init} studies\\nn = {n_total_init} participants']

  node2 [label = 'HCV detected / included\\nn = {n_kept_hcv}']
  excl2 [label = 'Excluded: HCV not detected / missing\\nn = {n_excl_hcv}',
         fillcolor = '#ffeeee']

  node3 [label = 'Transient elastography available\\nn = {n_kept_fsm}']
  excl3 [label = 'Excluded: Missing transient elastography\\nn = {n_excl_fsm}',
         fillcolor = '#ffeeee']

    node4 [label = 'Valid transient elastography\nn = {n_kept_fsm - n_excl_val}']

    node5 [label = 'Included in analysis\nk = {k_final} studies\nn = {n_final} participants',
      fillcolor = '#ccffcc',
      penwidth = 2]

    excl4 [label = 'Excluded: Invalid transient elastography\n(IQR/median > 30%)\nn = {n_excl_val}',
      fillcolor = '#ffeeee']

    excl5 [label = 'Excluded: Missing age\nn = {n_excl_age}',
      fillcolor = '#ffeeee']

  # --- Main flow ---
  node0 -> node1
  node1 -> node2
  node2 -> node3
  node3 -> node4
  node4 -> node5

  # --- Exclusion branches ---
  node0 -> excl0 [minlen = 2]
  node1 -> excl2 [minlen = 2]
  node2 -> excl3 [minlen = 2]
  node3 -> excl4 [minlen = 2]
  node4 -> excl5 [minlen = 2]

  # --- Alignment ---
  {{ rank = same; node0; excl0 }}
  {{ rank = same; node1; excl2 }}
  {{ rank = same; node2; excl3 }}
  {{ rank = same; node3; excl4 }}
  {{ rank = same; node4; excl5 }}
}}
")

# 5. Render
viz <- grViz(diagram_code)

viz

# Dedicated export folder (requested)
out_dir <- file.path("Results", "PRISMA_flow")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

svg_text <- export_svg(viz)
svg_path <- file.path(out_dir, "PRISMA_flow.svg")
writeLines(svg_text, svg_path)

# PNG @ 300 DPI (no title)
magick::image_read(svg_path, density = 300) %>%
  magick::image_write(
    path = file.path(out_dir, "PRISMA_flow.png"),
    format = "png",
    density = "300x300"
  )

# PDF export (vector)
charToRaw(svg_text) %>%
  rsvg_pdf(file.path(out_dir, "PRISMA_flow.pdf"))

# Submission EPS: use the generic exclusion categories and counts above.
dir.create("outputs/figures", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
rsvg::rsvg_eps(charToRaw(svg_text), "outputs/figures/Figure_1_600dpi.eps")

# Backwards-compatible copies in Results/Descriptives
dir.create("Results/Descriptives", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
file.copy(file.path(out_dir, "PRISMA_flow.png"), "Results/Descriptives/PRISMA_flow.png", overwrite = TRUE)
file.copy(file.path(out_dir, "PRISMA_flow.pdf"), "Results/Descriptives/PRISMA_flow.pdf", overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r}

# 5b. Optional ggplot version (custom IPD flow)
make_prisma_ggplot <- function(
  k_total_evaluated,
  n_studies_init,
  n_total_init,
  n_excl_hcv,
  n_kept_hcv,
  n_excl_fsm,
  n_kept_fsm,
  n_excl_val,
  n_excl_age,
  k_final,
  n_final
) {
  box_w <- 3.8
  box_h <- 0.85
  x_main <- 0
  x_excl <- 5.3

  nodes <- tibble::tibble(
    key = c("node0", "node1", "node2", "node3", "node4", "node5", "excl0", "excl2", "excl3", "excl4", "excl5"),
    x = c(x_main, x_main, x_main, x_main, x_main, x_main, x_excl, x_excl, x_excl, x_excl, x_excl),
    y = c(5, 4, 3, 2, 1, 0, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1),
    label = c(
      glue::glue("Studies evaluated for eligibility\n(k = {k_total_evaluated} studies)"),
      glue::glue("IPD obtained\n(k = {n_studies_init} studies; n = {n_total_init} participants)"),
      glue::glue("HCV detected / included\n(n = {n_kept_hcv})"),
      glue::glue("Transient elastography available\n(n = {n_kept_fsm})"),
      glue::glue("Valid transient elastography\n(n = {n_kept_fsm - n_excl_val})"),
      glue::glue("Included in analysis\n(k = {k_final} studies;\nn = {n_final} participants)"),
      glue::glue(
        "Excluded studies\n\n",
        "Clinical trials among people with acute/recent HCV infection, k = {k_excl_acute_trials}\n",
        "Clinical trials among people with chronic HCV infection that excluded people with cirrhosis, k = {k_excl_chronic_no_cirr_rct}\n",
        "Cohort studies among people with HCV infection that did not include transient elastography, k = {k_excl_no_te_cohort}\n",
        "Cohort studies among people with HCV infection that excluded those with cirrhosis, k = {k_excl_no_cirr_cohort}\n",
      ),
      glue::glue("Excluded: HCV not detected / missing\n(n = {n_excl_hcv})"),
      glue::glue("Excluded: Missing transient elastography\n(n = {n_excl_fsm})"),
      glue::glue("Excluded: Invalid transient elastography\n(IQR/median > 30%)\n(n = {n_excl_val})"),
      glue::glue("Excluded: Missing age\n(n = {n_excl_age})")
    ),
    fill = rep("white", 11)
  )

  main_edges <- tibble::tibble(
    x = x_main,
    xend = x_main,
    y = c(5, 4, 3, 2, 1),
    yend = c(4, 3, 2, 1, 0),
    linetype = "solid"
  )

  excl_edges <- tibble::tibble(
    x = x_main + box_w / 2,
    xend = x_excl - box_w / 2,
    y = c(5, 4, 3, 2, 1),
    yend = c(5, 4, 3, 2, 1),
    linetype = "dashed"
  )

  ggplot() +
    geom_rect(
      data = nodes,
      aes(
        xmin = x - box_w / 2,
        xmax = x + box_w / 2,
        ymin = y - box_h / 2,
        ymax = y + box_h / 2,
        fill = fill
      ),
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 0.25
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = nodes,
      aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
      size = 2.6,
      lineheight = 0.98
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = main_edges,
      aes(x = x, y = y - box_h / 2, xend = xend, yend = yend + box_h / 2),
      linewidth = 0.25,
      arrow = grid::arrow(length = grid::unit(0.14, "cm"), type = "closed")
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = excl_edges,
      aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend, linetype = linetype),
      linewidth = 0.22,
      arrow = grid::arrow(length = grid::unit(0.14, "cm"), type = "closed")
    ) +
    scale_fill_identity() +
    scale_linetype_identity() +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-3.2, 9.0), ylim = c(-0.8, 5.8), clip = "off") +
    theme_void(base_family = "Helvetica")
}

# 6. Export



# ggplot exports (PNG + PDF)
gg_viz <- make_prisma_ggplot(
  k_total_evaluated = k_total_evaluated,
  n_studies_init = n_studies_init,
  n_total_init = n_total_init,
  n_excl_hcv = n_excl_hcv,
  n_kept_hcv = n_kept_hcv,
  n_excl_fsm = n_excl_fsm,
  n_kept_fsm = n_kept_fsm,
  n_excl_val = n_excl_val,
  n_excl_age = n_excl_age,
  k_final = k_final,
  n_final = n_final
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "PRISMA_flow_ggplot.png"),
  plot = gg_viz,
  width = 180,
  height = 200,
  units = "mm",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "PRISMA_flow_ggplot.pdf"),
  plot = gg_viz,
  width = 180,
  height = 200,
  units = "mm"
)

# 7. Display in RStudio / HTML
viz
```
